Luxury Cruise Passengers Stranded in Cambodia After Fuel Costs Rise

Passengers aboard the MV Odyssey, who had paid for a "never-ending retirement at sea" or a "lifetime at sea on an endless cruise," have been left stranded in Cambodia. The dream voyage was disrupted by an oil shock attributed to rising fuel costs, which led to the passengers being "unceremoniously dumped" in the country. The cruise was initially promoted as an "ultimate escape."
